name: Debug Push Permissions

on:
  push:
    branches: ['*']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  security_events: read

jobs:
  debug:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Log environment details
        run: |
          echo "=== Environment Details ==="
          echo "Node version: $(node -v)"
          echo "NPM version: $(npm -v)"
          echo "Git version: $(git --version)"
          echo "GITHUB_REF: ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo "GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}"
          echo "GITHUB_WORKSPACE: ${{ github.workspace }}"
          echo "GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}"
          echo "GITHUB_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}"
          echo "GITHUB_ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}"
          echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS: ${{ github.action }}"
          echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}"
          echo "GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}"
          echo "GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}"
          echo "GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}"
          echo "GITHUB_REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}"
          echo "GITHUB_REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}"

      - name: Check auth status
        run: |
          echo "=== Auth Status ==="
          status=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" https://api.github.com/user)
          echo "HTTP status code: $status"
          if [ "$status" -eq 200 ]; then
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is valid."
          else
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is not valid."
          fi

      - name: Fetch branch protection rules
        run: |
          echo "=== Branch Protection Rules for ${{ github.ref_name }} ==="
          curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/branches/${{ github.ref_name }}/protection | jq .
        continue-on-error: true
